SubstrateSide=BottomSide with an otherwise default frame - LowerLeft/UpRight - so the side is the only thing that differs from the corpus baseline. SubstrateSide is a COORDINATE-SYSTEM attribute: its XSD default is TopSide, so an absent one positively asserts the top face, and reading the bottom face as the top mirrors every cell. All twelve tokens are distinct, so a mirror is visible rather than plausible.
